note: Every GITHUB_TOKEN write grant in .github/workflows/*.yml, keyed by workflow basename, job (null = workflow-level) and scope. ops/tests/test_github_workflows.sh fails on any write or write-all not listed here, on an entry whose keys are not exactly workflow/job/scope/reason or whose job is neither null nor a non-empty string, on an entry without a reason, and on an entry that no longer matches a grant.

entries.reason: POSTs the agent-review check run on the exact PR head; runs from the trusted base via pull_request_target and never checks out PR code.
ops/doctor_issue.py creates the health-report label and opens, edits or closes the single self-updating health-report issue.

ops/main_watch.py opens one P1 main-red issue per red area, or comments the failing run on it, after a push-triggered area suite fails on main; it runs from the default branch and never checks out PR code.
